data.title: 鸿雪 · 海蚀凉亭下倚靠藤编沙发书写童话的惬意片刻
data.action: 侧卧在面朝大海的白色藤编软榻上，羽毛笔点在翻开的精装笔记本边缘，狼耳轻颤，侧眸含情注视
data.location: 热带绝壁之上的私人露天白色穹顶观景凉亭
data.lighting: 穿透白色纱幔的柔美漫射光线，海平面的微光给粉色长发与华丽披风染上一层珍珠般的温润光泽
data.mood: 文雅高贵、慵懒惬意与沉浸在诗意中的温存
data.description: 海风将凉亭垂挂的纯白纱幔吹得如烟似雾。鸿雪优雅地斜倚在堆满丝绒靠枕的藤榻上，蓬松的鲁珀长尾在裙边惬意地微微扫动。她放下手中的特制羽毛笔，在写满娟秀文字的羊皮纸旁合上书页，唇角泛起温柔如蜜的笑意——「大海与杜林的孩子们一样纯真，让人忍不住写下新的诗句。不过……在完成这篇故事之前，博士，能请你坐到我身边，为我的下一段乐章提供一些灵感吗？」
data.promptProse: Pozyomka reclines gracefully on a pillowed white rattan daybed beneath a cliffside coastal pavilion, wearing a dusty-rose and champagne-gold embroidered bikini with sheer chiffon sleeves and a gold-trimmed wrap skirt. Resting a feather quill on her open hardcover notebook as sea breezes lift the sheer white drapes, she offers a serene, affectionate smile.
data.animaCaption: Reclining languidly on a cushioned white rattan daybed in her dusty-rose gold-embroidered bikini, sheer chiffon sleeves, and wrap skirt, she pauses with a feather quill poised over her open notebook and smiles warmly toward the viewer. Sheer white cabana drapes billow softly against the afternoon sea horizon.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a dusty-rose and champagne-gold embroidered resort bikini paired with flowing sheer chiffon sleeves and a gold-trimmed wrap skirt.
